scheduler.project_fairness_rule: after one bounded repair attempt on the highest-priority blocked lane, service other unblocked independent projects in the same run
scheduler.orchestrator_starvation_guard: orchestrator maintenance must not consume the only substantive implementation slot while executable P0-P5 product work exists

compatibility_planning.rule: identify direct and transitive consumers before shared-contract changes; prepare dependents first for breaking changes and never knowingly leave the Knowledge Engine family broken

learning_memory.persist_rule: verified, sanitized lessons only; never persist secrets, credentials, raw private Product Reality payloads, or unverified conclusions

tooling_leverage.rule: adopt free maintainable tools only when they close an observed feedback-loop gap; prefer official implementations, least privilege, local/advisory introduction before material CI cost, and never report availability before verification

permanently_unknown_metrics.blocked_waiting_seconds: GitHub exposes only current mergeable_state, not a historical blocked timeline
permanently_unknown_metrics.preflight_failures_prevented_count: local preflight runs leave no committed, API-accessible trace
permanently_unknown_metrics.product_reality_debt_created_count: Product Reality is human validation, not CI-inferable
permanently_unknown_metrics.product_reality_debt_resolved_count: Product Reality is human validation, not CI-inferable
permanently_unknown_metrics.autonomous_intervention_count: no deterministic GitHub signal distinguishes autonomous vs. required intervention
permanently_unknown_metrics.jeremy_required_intervention_count: no deterministic GitHub signal distinguishes autonomous vs. required intervention

automatic_evidence_collector.idempotency: incremental via prior window_end per (project, repository), plus explicit evidence_ref dedup independent of --since
forbidden: ingesting raw webhook payloads, signatures, tokens, or credentials
fabricating a measurement for a metric with no reliable source
granting the reinvestment controller execution or merge authority

deterministic_repair_engine.execution_boundary: local working tree only; engine does not commit, push, open PRs, merge, weaken checks, or alter Product Reality evidence
deterministic_repair_engine.regression_rule: recurring verified failure fingerprints should be promoted into earlier repository-native prevention when practical

parallel_specialist_lanes.stale_rule: default-branch head change invalidates lane until revalidated
parallel_specialist_lanes.knowledge_engine_rule: one coordinated parent lane with Core/Web/AI sublanes; shared-contract changes require compatibility clearance

predictive_work_decomposition.task_source: explicit authoritative roadmap/design candidate slices only
predictive_work_decomposition.score_semantics: ordinal structural priority only; never duration/ROI/probability/readiness percent
predictive_work_decomposition.output: conflict-aware dependency waves for specialist-lane reservation

automatic_regression_prevention.action: recommend earlier repository-native prevention; actual product-repo change remains normal engineering work with preflight/CI

portfolio_throughput_optimizer.eligibility_rule: rank only projects already eligible after P0-P4, product authority, dependency, ownership, and Product Reality gates
portfolio_throughput_optimizer.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN and INSUFFICIENT_DATA are omitted and never coerced to zero
portfolio_throughput_optimizer.score_semantics: ordinal measured bottleneck severity only; never predicted gain/ROI/probability/capacity percentage/readiness percent

branch_reconciliation.execution_boundary: fresh local modernization branch from exact verified default head; replay only explicitly authorized unique commits; repository-approved formatting/targeted tests/full preflight; never rewrites source branch, deletes refs, pushes, opens PRs, or merges

autonomous_engineering_agent.infrastructure_expansion_policy: freeze after v1 unless measured recurring friction, a concrete execution blocker, or a failed control invariant justifies a bounded improvement

orchestration.rule: promotion requires FULL GREEN preflight evidence whose repository and head_sha exactly match the completed workflow run and the branch must still point at that SHA; fresh PR CI remains independently required

area_specific_learning.timing: before repository mutation after candidate scope is known
area_specific_learning.rule: surface relevant prevention rules before edits; retrieved learning informs prevention but never overrides product repository authority
area_specific_learning.cross_repository_rule: product lessons do not cross-pollinate other products; portfolio lessons require actual query overlap

branch_lifecycle_manager.deletion_rule: delete only when complete live evidence proves no open PR, no active ownership, no release/hotfix or preservation requirement, and no unique unmerged work; default branch is never eligible
branch_lifecycle_manager.stale_value_rule: authorized diverged unique work is queued for branch modernization rather than deleted
branch_lifecycle_manager.execution_boundary: this slice classifies and emits deletion/recovery candidates; destructive ref deletion remains a separate connector action requiring live revalidation immediately before mutation

measured_self_improvement.unknown_policy: predicted ROI, time saved, and success probability remain UNKNOWN unless independently measured
measured_self_improvement.implementation_rule: authorized reversible improvements still require branch -> exact-head preflight -> PR -> fresh CI

learning_effectiveness.rule: record only VERIFIED evidence that a known lesson was actually applied to a later change; effectiveness requires evidence of prevention, earlier detection, shorter repair, or successful-pattern reuse
learning_effectiveness.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN and insufficient evidence must never be coerced into success
learning_effectiveness.target: increase verified effective applications while driving preventable repeat failures toward zero

scheduler_executive_reporting.rule: report executive KPIs from explicit run evidence; orchestrator-only work cannot satisfy product throughput; eligible non-advanced projects require reason plus exact next gate
scheduler_executive_reporting.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN is preferred to invented evidence

product_reality_debt.rule: aggregate Product Reality debt by independent product and dependency_scope; active debt blocks only dependent work

closed_loop_product_run.advancement_rule: ELIGIBLE product advancement requires ACT and VERIFY evidence
closed_loop_product_run.closure_rule: LEARN and ADAPT must be COMPLETE or NOT_APPLICABLE for each independent product
closed_loop_product_run.advancement_evidence_rule: claimed product advancement requires explicit execution_evidence_ref and verification_evidence_ref; narrative stage completion is insufficient

pre_change_risk_predictor.timing: after candidate scope is known and before repository mutation
pre_change_risk_predictor.rule: surface historically matching failure classes and successful patterns before edits; apply prevention/reuse rules without inventing probability or overriding repository authority

process_experiments.authority: governed engineering only; experiments never self-merge or weaken gates
process_experiments.keep_rule: requires measured target improvement and preserved safety/quality invariants
process_experiments.unknown_rule: missing, UNKNOWN, or incomplete evidence resolves to INSUFFICIENT_DATA

foreman.role: single portfolio lane controller over exactly four independent products
foreman.ownership_source: live GitHub PRs/issues/branches/commits plus terminal worker evidence
foreman.history_policy: terminal execution history is bounded archival evidence and does not participate in normal scheduling
foreman.dispatch_rule: at most one substantial dispatch-ready slice per eligible independent product per run
foreman.asynchronous_wait_rule: waiting gates do not consume another product lane

steward.role: machine-health governor and dispatch admission controller
steward.unknown_telemetry_rule: preserve as evidence gap; never manufacture healthy state
steward.daily_reboot_boundary: daily LaptopActor hygiene plus optional pre-reboot wrapper; existing 02:00 reboot is preserved when Task Scheduler mutation is denied

shared_engineering_memory.name: Iron Memory
shared_engineering_memory.trust_rule: only VERIFIED sanitized lessons may be materialized; live repository evidence and repository-local authority always outrank memory
shared_engineering_memory.write_rule: agents do not write arbitrary conversation history; new lessons enter through the existing verified learning-memory contract

issue_closure_engine.inventory_rule: use complete paginated open issue evidence from all six product repositories; truncated recent issue views are not scheduling authority
issue_closure_engine.scheduling_rule: issues enter the existing legal product frontier after P0-P4, repository authority, ownership, dependency, and Product Reality gates; within a legal issue frontier rank product impact deterministically
issue_closure_engine.closure_rule: merge alone never closes an issue; require verified disposition/reproduction, implementation verification, regression disposition, required CI, default-branch merge, default-branch proof, and Product Reality when required
issue_closure_engine.orphan_rule: every actionable live issue requires an explicit engineering state and exact next gate
